inputs.label: Spectral color
inputs.coverage: Published MapCam false-color composite over 550 nm normal reflectance. Red shows the 847/550 nm ratio, green the 698 nm band strength, and blue the 473/550 nm ratio. These colors show spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. Coverage extends to about 65° north and south; omitted shadows and gaps use the gray grid. The controlled map is draped on the simplified OLA shape, so individual boulders need not align precisely.
